notes: NEX3 Arbitration Decision Object schema · founder-authorised research artefact 2026-09-12. Controlled prototype · no runtime · no doctrine mutation. NEX3 is the evidence-based arbiter, NOT a winner-picker. Every arbitration produces a decision object reproducible from evidence.

required_fields.name: request_id
required_fields.shape: string · links to the originating Work Order

required_fields.name: user_objective
required_fields.shape: string · founder or user-authored statement of intent

required_fields.name: project_constraints
required_fields.shape: object · project style · frameworks · existing conventions

required_fields.name: criteria_scores
required_fields.shape: object · every criterion has {score, evidence, rationale}

required_fields.name: decision
required_fields.shape: enum · CANDIDATE_A · CANDIDATE_B · EXISTING_CODE_BETTER · BOTH_INFERIOR · HOLD_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE · CLARIFY_USER_INTENT
required_fields.note: 'always choose one' is REJECTED · correctness > forced resolution

required_fields.name: limitations
required_fields.shape: string · what this decision does NOT cover

required_fields.name: rollback_plan
required_fields.shape: string · how to undo the accepted candidate if regression appears

verdict_types.meaning: neither candidate improves on the current code · take no action
both are worse than existing · request rethink
evidence cannot support any verdict · SH-3-style honest hold
user_objective is ambiguous · verdict withheld pending clarification

invariants: NEX3 verdict is reproducible from evidence · not from persuasion
NEX3 may return HOLD or CLARIFY · never forced to CHOOSE
criteria_scores must include ALL 14 required criteria · absence is treated as evidence-quality=insufficient
minimum_necessary_complexity criterion may not be optimised for smaller code · trade-offs must be recorded
every criterion score must cite the evidence source (benchmark id · metric id · adversarial fixture id)
no verdict can override Origin Protection · Safety · Authorisation
arbitration is advisory to the founder for the first N sprints · never binding until explicit AUTHORISE
hold_conditions: adversarial fixtures absent for the operation kind
